app.title: VisualMark Studio
app.subtitle: Professional Markdown Editor, Architecture Visualizer & Documentation Engineering Studio

welcome.cloneRepoDesc: Clone from GitHub, GitLab, or Git URL directly to your machine.
welcome.openFolderDesc: Open an existing local project folder or documentation repository from disk.

settings.title: Settings
settings.resetConfirm: Reset all editor and application settings to defaults?
settings.searchPlaceholder: Search settings (e.g. font, wrap, theme, git, indentation)...

appearance.title: Appearance & Window
appearance.languageDesc: Select the interface display language for VisualMark Studio.
appearance.removeConfirm: Are you sure you want to remove the custom language pack '{name}'?
appearance.contributeGithub: Contribute or suggest translation fixes on GitHub ↗
appearance.colorThemeDesc: Specifies the color theme used in the workbench, editor canvas, and markdown preview.
appearance.tabGroupingDesc: Organize open studio tools, markdown documents, and presets into collapsible Chrome/Arc-style categories.
appearance.zoomLevelDesc: Adjust the display zoom level across the application interface.
appearance.splitOrientationDesc: Default split layout for the code editor and live markdown preview.
appearance.welcomeStartup: Workbench: Show Welcome Page on Startup
appearance.welcomeStartupDesc: Open the Welcome / Getting Started dashboard when launching VisualMark Studio.

editor.title: Text Editor
editor.engineDesc: Choose between the high-performance Monaco Editor (with minimap, code folding, smart autocompletion) or the Classic lightweight editor.
editor.fontSizeDesc: Controls the font size in pixels for the markdown editor.
editor.fontFamilyDesc: Controls the font family used in the editor canvas.
editor.tabSizeDesc: The number of spaces a tab is equal to.
editor.wordWrapDesc: Lines will wrap to the viewport width.
editor.lineNumbersDesc: Show line numbers on the left editor gutter.
editor.syncScrollDesc: Synchronize editor scroll position with the live markdown preview.
editor.formatOnSaveDesc: Automatically format markdown tables, links, and code blocks when saving.
editor.autoSaveDesc: Controls how dirty files are automatically saved.

toolbar.title: Floating Quick-Action Toolbar
toolbar.enableDesc: When text is highlighted in the editor, display a floating HUD with quick formatting actions, headings, lists, and callout insertion.

files.title: Files & Exporting
files.badgeStyleDesc: Aesthetic appearance used when inserting dynamic repository badges.
files.pdfSizeDesc: Standard page format used when generating printable PDF documents.

notifications.title: Notifications & Toasts
notifications.toastLevelDesc: Controls which notifications pop up as floating cards over your workspace. Routine operations are muted to prevent distraction.
notifications.historyDesc: Currently storing {count} notification(s). Clear history log from Notification Center.

updates.title: Application Updates
updates.autoDownloadDesc: When enabled (Automatic), updates are downloaded silently in the background. When disabled (Manual), VisualMark Studio asks for your confirmation before downloading.

github.title: AI Providers & Integrations
github.tokenDesc: Increases GitHub API rate limits from 60 to 5,000 requests/hour and enables scanning of private repositories. Stored only on your local device.

unsupported.title: Cannot Open File in Editor
unsupported.descMedia: This media file cannot be rendered inside the plain text code editor.
unsupported.descBinary: This file contains binary or compiled data that cannot be displayed as plain text.
unsupported.openDefaultDesc: Launch this file using your system's default viewer or player.
unsupported.revealDesc: Open containing directory and highlight this file in Windows File Explorer.
